guard_change.note: Changing guard costs this much stamina (owner decision t98u). Weapon perks may make some changes free.

_meta.note: Guard sets. Each weapon in weapons.json names its guard_set and its stance_tree (guards it can reach). Each guard has a type (offensive/defensive/neutral) that maps to rules/stances.json for stamina handling; the guard's own numbers are used for attack and defence.

2H_sword.source: Liechtenauer (Ringeck/Döbringer glosses) and Fiore dei Liberi, Fior di Battaglia

vom_tag.name: Vom Tag (From the Roof)
vom_tag.description: A high guard that favors powerful downward strikes and aggressive pressure.

half_sword.name: Half-Swording
half_sword.description: A close-range grappling stance allowing precise thrusts and strong defensive control.

wrath_guard.name: Wrath Guard
wrath_guard.description: A balanced stance ready to shift into attack or defense quickly.

ochs.name: Ochs (Ox)
ochs.description: High guard with point forward at head height, simulating ox horns, good for thrusts from above.

pflug.name: Pflug (Plow)
pflug.description: Low guard at hip height, point forward, mimicking a plow, strong for thrusts and parries.

alber.name: Alber (Fool)
alber.description: Deceptive low guard with point down, provoking attacks to counter swiftly.

porta_di_ferro.name: Porta di Ferro (Iron Door)
porta_di_ferro.description: Strong low guard close to the ground, ideal for awaiting and breaking attacks.

posta_di_donna.name: Posta di Donna (Woman’s Guard)
posta_di_donna.description: High guard above shoulder, breaks other guards with powerful strikes.

posta_di_fenestra.name: Posta di Fenestra (Window Guard)
posta_di_fenestra.description: Deceptive high guard, quick for covers, strikes, and transitions.

dente_di_zenghiaro.name: Dente di Zenghiaro (Boar’s Tooth)
dente_di_zenghiaro.description: Low guard mimicking boar’s tusk, strong for underhand thrusts.

1H_sword.source: Liechtenauer guards adapted to one hand; Fiore/Bolognese (Marozzo) one-hand guards

vom_tag.name: Vom Tag (From the Roof)
vom_tag.description: High guard for powerful downward strikes.

guardia_alta.name: Guardia Alta (High Guard)
guardia_alta.description: High guard for downward cuts and thrusts.

porta_di_ferro.name: Porta di Ferro (Iron Gate)
porta_di_ferro.description: Low guard strong against incoming attacks.

guardia_di_testa.name: Guardia di Testa (Head Guard)
guardia_di_testa.description: Protects the head, ready for counters.

2H_hammer.source: Owner's guard names kept; defined after Le Jeu de la Hache (c.1400) and Fiore's poleaxe holds (high blow, short-haft cover, middle)

crater_maker.name: Crater Maker (High Hammer)
crater_maker.description: Head raised high over the shoulder for a full descending blow, like Fiore's Posta di Donna with the axe. Strong but open.

counterweight.name: Counterweight (Short Haft)
counterweight.description: Hands spread on the haft, head low and back: the haft parries and the queue (butt) can strike, as in Le Jeu de la Hache.

impact_form.name: Impact Form (Middle)
impact_form.description: Head forward at middle height, ready to strike, thrust with the beak or fall back to the haft.

1H_blunt.source: Filled in: no surviving mace treatise; holds taken from period art and messer/axe guards (Talhoffer, Lecküchner)

high_guard.name: High Guard
high_guard.description: Mace raised for the overhead blow at the helm.

hanging_guard.name: Hanging Guard
hanging_guard.description: Haft angled across the body, head down, covering with the shaft.

axe.source: Filled in: Norse/Dane axe has no treatise; high/low/middle holds from Le Jeu de la Hache and period art

high_guard.name: High Guard
high_guard.description: Axe raised for the overhead chop.

low_guard.name: Low Guard
low_guard.description: Head low, beard ready to hook shield, leg or weapon.

middle_guard.name: Middle Guard
middle_guard.description: Haft forward, ready to cut or check.

polearm.source: Fiore dei Liberi, Fior di Battaglia (poleaxe and spear guards); Le Jeu de la Hache

posta_di_donna_sinestra.name: Posta di Donna la Sinestra
posta_di_donna_sinestra.description: Fiore's high left-side poleaxe guard, for the great descending blow.

posta_breve_serpentina.name: Posta Breve la Serpentina
posta_breve_serpentina.description: Fiore's short serpent guard: point forward at the face, ready to thrust and change.

tutta_porta_di_ferro.name: Tutta Porta di Ferro
tutta_porta_di_ferro.description: Fiore's full iron gate: point low, waiting to beat aside and hook.

dente_di_zenghiaro.name: Dente di Zenghiaro
dente_di_zenghiaro.description: Boar's tooth: low point rising, the queue ready to strike from below.

dagger.source: Fiore dei Liberi, Fior di Battaglia, dagger section (posta longa, mezana porta di ferro; the overhand 'sopramano' grip of the fendente stab). Numbers filled in.

sopramano.name: Sopramano (overhand)
sopramano.description: Dagger held point-down, raised for the downward stab.

mezana_porta_di_ferro.name: Mezana Porta di Ferro
mezana_porta_di_ferro.description: Middle iron door: dagger hand low and forward, free hand ready.

posta_longa.name: Posta Longa
posta_longa.description: Free arm extended to meet the stab and bind the arm.
